'''Alexander Meseguer''' (also published as '''Alex Meseguer''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon II]] on 6 May 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit (Jedi Pack Han)]], according to Derek Halpern's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d703">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapo-con-ll-5-6-00d703/ ramapo-con-ll-5-6-00], DeckTech (Derek "Datasta" Halpern, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapo-con-ll-5-6-00d703/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Alexander Meseguer also played at [[September 2000 Cedar Grove tournament]] on 9 September 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|Dark Deal (Combat Response start)]] and [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1229">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-14-cedar-grove-nj-9-sep-00d1229/ cedar-grove-nj-9-sep-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 14 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-14-cedar-grove-nj-9-sep-00d1229/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
